name: Silhouette Detection via Laplacian Filter
definition: A method to detect object silhouettes to stop advection over geometric boundaries, preventing 'particles' from flowing across surface boundaries which would make geometry and topology unrecognizable.
summary: Silhouette Detection via Laplacian Filter identifies object boundaries in image space by applying a discrete Laplacian filter to depth values, replacing exhaustive 3D subspace searches to prevent advection particles from crossing geometric edges.
